summary: Lake Region Healthcare Corporation, operating multiple locations in Minnesota, reported unauthorized network access discovered on or about May 19, 2025, with investigation completed June 5, 2026. The breach exposed names, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, medical record numbers, patient account numbers, health insurance information, contact information, medical/treatment information, government-issued ID data, and financial information. Affected individuals are being notified by mail, and law firms are investigating potential class action lawsuits.
